ai_en: Oh, what a pickle we are in! cried Amy, as she hunted in vain for the missing ticket.
Jo gave a shriek of delight and clapped her hands.
Jo pressed the letter to her bosom and ran up to her room.
Her answer was full of wit, and the girls laughed till the tears came.
It was a vanity, she knew, but the little mirror gave her great delight.
The pious old lady shook her head over the girls' worldly ambitions.
Humble as their home was, the girls were proud of it.
